integrity.independent_audit: No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
integrity.mathematical_claim: All-size quotient equilibrium energy/index polynomial, sharp switching barrier, first-saddle sublevel homotopy, and symmetric-windmill basin consequence.
integrity.verification: Analytic proof plus independent reconstruction of original-coordinate gradients, Hessians, and sampled minimax paths for finite examples.

limitations: Uniform negative unit edge coupling and identical natural frequencies only.
The main Morse sublevel classification is confined to the interval below the second distinct critical energy.
The original-coordinate flow is not asserted to separate across triangles.
Exact full basin measures are claimed only for the symmetric friendship graph, and numerical verification is finite.
An unindexed prior equivalent all-size cactus barrier/homotopy result remains possible.
title: First-barrier topology and exact Morse census of repulsive Kuramoto dynamics on triangular cacti
